understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn I could MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT (horizontal only). After any horizontal move, gravity (here: DOWN) automatically carried the character until it landed on a solid/support tile, hit a hazard, or reached the goal. CLICK could remove specific clickable/breakable tiles at a given [x,y] without moving the character, typically to open a path in the gravity direction; clicks did not count as movement turns for moving-platform timers (when present). Landing on spikes ('u'/'v') immediately ended the attempt. UNDO could revert the previous action to recover from a mistake. Each attempt had a fixed turn budget and levels allowed limited attempts.
